method: Primary documentation review; no application execution, platform parity or future compatibility guarantee.
description: Compare personal task capture, project organization and scheduling in Things 3, native OmniFocus 4 perpetual editions and direct-purchase 2Do Mac. Apple platforms and purchase channels differ; optional Web access, future upgrades and update eligibility have separate costs. Draft review; publication is not approved.

candidates.pricing: Things 3: separate one-time Apple-platform purchases; Things Cloud sync has no extra charge.
candidates.limits: Apple platforms only; no real-time shared lists. Separate platform purchases; future major upgrades are not guaranteed free.

candidates.pricing: Native OmniFocus 4 Standard or Pro perpetual license includes 4.x updates and the supported Apple platforms.
candidates.limits: Web access and all-access plans are recurring subscriptions. Future major upgrades are separate; Pro-only features are excluded from Standard workflow comparisons.

candidates.pricing: Direct-store 2Do Mac perpetual license includes 18 months of updates from purchase; optional renewal adds update eligibility.
candidates.limits: Mac App Store and Setapp editions use subscriptions. Keep the last eligible direct version without renewal; future macOS/sync compatibility is not guaranteed. iPhone/iPad are separate purchases; Android is outside this Mac workflow review.
